finding: A work order could omit allowed_git_commands and forbidden_commands while still looking complete.
fix: Added required allowed_git_commands and forbidden_commands fields to startup and skill-injection rules.

finding: Review could catch unauthorized commit/push outcome but not git directives, missing command lists, or reconciliation flag contradiction.
fix: Added checks to plan-review, phase-completion, implementation-integrity, generated-code-review, and session-constitution skills.

finding: P37 state recorded committed/pushed while commit_push_authorized=false without explicit violation quarantine semantics.
fix: P37A state records the P37 violation and requires quarantine_pending_parent_validation plus parent review before continuing feature/training/model work.
